criteria.criterion: The deterministic child-closure/certification result (counts, and the ids of any unclosed/uncertified children) is surfaced to the completion verifier as evidence, inside the existing fenced-context delimiter — build_child_closure_evidence() injects counts + uncertified ids into context INSIDE the <untrusted_ticket_context> fence

A criterion of the form 'every child is closed' can be resolved from that evidence without the verifier making a tool call — the block states 'N direct children; all closed & certified' or lists unclosed/uncertified ids

The Gerrit half (Verified +1) is explicitly addressed: completion_verifier.md (trusted) tells the verifier the Gerrit Verified+1 half is out of repo-tool reach and not to FAIL solely for it when closure+cert is proven

A test pins that the evidence appears in the verify step's inputs and that its content matches what child_closure_findings returned — tests/unit/workflow/test_child_closure_evidence_6ec8.py (RED->GREEN, mutation-checked)

No change to the deterministic short-circuit: an UNCLOSED direct child must still block with no LLM call — AC5 regression asserts an unclosed direct child still short-circuits (run_verify=False, no LLM)
Bug 'Child-closure proof is computed deterministically then hidden from the completion verifier' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds
